cite_runs: – journalist for the Byline Times “Can the West and Russia Co-operate to Save a Melting Arctic?” Byline Times, 9/16,
body: Jennifer Spence is Project Director of the Arctic Initiative at the Harvard Kennedy School’s Belfer Center for Science and International Affairs
Spence said it was getting increasingly difficult for Western scientists to maintain any kind of relationships with Russian researchers. “
There are more restrictions and more concerns about the personal safety of researchers in Russia
The Russian government does not want Russian scientists to participate
and so Russian researchers are starting to feel that pressure.”
